record.bible_text: <FO><FO>To the chief Musician<WH05329><WTH8764> on Neginoth<WH05058>, Maschil<WH04905><WTH8688>, <FI>A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Give ear<WH0238><WTH8685> to my prayer<WH08605>, O God<WH0430>; and hide<WH05956><WTH8691> not thyself from my supplication<WH08467>. <RF>chief...: or, overseer<Rf> <RF>Maschil: or, of instruction<Rf>
Attend<WH07181><WTH8685> unto me, and hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me: I mourn<WH07300><WTH8686> in my complaint<WH07879>, and make a noise<WH01949><WTH8686>;

Because of the voice<WH06963> of the enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, because<WH06440> of the oppression<WH06125> of the wicked<WH07563>: for they cast<WH04131><WTH8686> iniquity<WH0205> upon me, and in wrath<WH0639> they hate<WH07852><WTH8799> me.
My heart<WH03820> is sore pained<WH02342><WTH8799> within<WH07130> me: and the terrors<WH0367> of death<WH04194> are fallen<WH05307><WTH8804> upon me.
Fearfulness<WH03374> and trembling<WH07461> are come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon me, and horror<WH06427> hath overwhelmed<WH03680><WTH8762> me. <RF>overwhelmed: Heb. covered<Rf>
And I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Oh that<WH05414><WTH8799> I had wings<WH083> like a dove<WH03123>! <FI>for then<Fi> would I fly away<WH05774><WTH8799>, and be at rest<WH07931><WTH8799>.
Lo, <FI>then<Fi> would I wander<WH05074><WTH8800> far off<WH07368><WTH8686>, <FI>and<Fi> remain<WH03885><WTH8799> in the wilderness<WH04057>. Selah<WH05542>.
I would hasten<WH02363><WTH8686> my escape<WH04655> from the windy<WH07307> storm<WH05584><WTH8801> <FI>and<Fi> tempest<WH05591>.<CM>
Destroy<WH01104><WTH8761>, O Lord<WH0136>, <FI>and<Fi> divide<WH06385><WTH8761> their tongues<WH03956>: for I have seen<WH07200><WTH8804> violence<WH02555> and strife<WH07379> in the city<WH05892>.
Day<WH03119> and night<WH03915> they go about<WH05437><WTH8779> it upon the walls<WH02346> thereof: mischief<WH0205> also and sorrow<WH05999> <FI>are<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of it.
Wickedness<WH01942> <FI>is<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> thereof: deceit<WH08496> and guile<WH04820> depart<WH04185><WTH8686> not from her streets<WH07339>.

For <FI>it was<Fi> not an enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> <FI>that<Fi> reproached<WH02778><WTH8762> me; then I could have borne<WH05375><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> : neither <FI>was it<Fi> he that hated<WH08130><WTH8764> me <FI>that<Fi> did magnify<WH01431><WTH8689> <FI>himself<Fi> against me; then I would have hid<WH05641><WTH8735> myself from him:
But <FI>it was<Fi> thou, a man<WH0582> mine equal<WH06187>, my guide<WH0441>, and mine acquaintance<WH03045><WTH8794>. <RF>mine equal: Heb. according to my rank<Rf>

We took sweet<WH04985><WTH8686> counsel<WH05475> together<WH03162>, <FI>and<Fi> walked<WH01980><WTH8762> unto the house<WH01004> of God<WH0430> in company<WH07285>. <RF>We...: Heb. Who sweetened counsel<Rf>

Let death<WH04194> seize<WH05377><WTH8686><WTH8675><WH03451> upon them, <FI>and<Fi> let them go down<WH03381><WTH8799> quick<WH02416> into hell<WH07585>: for wickedness<WH07451> <FI>is<Fi> in their dwellings<WH04033>, <FI>and<Fi> among<WH07130> them. <RF>hell: or, the grave<Rf><CM>
As for me, I will call<WH07121><WTH8799> upon God<WH0430>; and the LORD<WH03068> shall save<WH03467><WTH8686> me.
Evening<WH06153>, and morning<WH01242>, and at noon<WH06672>, will I pray<WH07878><WTH8799>, and cry aloud<WH01993><WTH8799>: and he shall hear<WH08085><WTH8799> my voice<WH06963>.
He hath delivered<WH06299><WTH8804> my soul<WH05315> in peace<WH07965> from the battle<WH07128> <FI>that was<Fi> against me: for there were many<WH07227> with me.

God<WH0410> shall hear<WH08085><WTH8799>, and afflict<WH06030><WTH8799> them, even he that abideth<WH03427><WTH8802> of old<WH06924>. Selah<WH05542>. Because they have no changes<WH02487>, therefore they fear<WH03372><WTH8804> not God<WH0430>. <RF>Because...: or, With whom also there be no changes, yet they<Rf>
He hath put forth<WH07971><WTH8804> his hands<WH03027> against such as be at peace<WH07965> with him: he hath broken<WH02490><WTH8765> his covenant<WH01285>. <RF>broken: Heb. profaned<Rf>

<FI> The words<Fi> of his mouth<WH06310> were smoother<WH02505><WTH8804> than butter<WH04260>, but war<WH07128> <FI>was<Fi> in his heart<WH03820>: his words<WH01697> were softer<WH07401><WTH8804> than oil<WH08081>, yet <FI>were<Fi> they drawn swords<WH06609>.

Cast<WH07993><WTH8685> thy burden<WH03053> upon the LORD<WH03068>, and he shall sustain<WH03557><WTH8770> thee: he shall never<WH05769> suffer<WH05414><WTH8799> the righteous<WH06662> to be moved<WH04131><WTH8800>. <RF>burden: or, gift<Rf>

But thou, O God<WH0430>, shalt bring them down<WH03381><WTH8686> into the pit<WH0875> of destruction<WH07845>: bloody<WH01818> and deceitful<WH04820> men<WH0582> shall not live out half<WH02673><WTH8799> their days<WH03117>; but I will trust<WH0982><WTH8799> in thee. <RF>bloody...: Heb. men of bloods and deceit<Rf> <RF>shall...: Heb. shall not half their days<Rf><CM>
